snippet.title: The No Jumpscare Show - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play The NO JUMPSCARE Show for free on Itch.io right now:

🔗 https://polypaw.itch.io/the-no-jumpscare-show

Coming to Steam as a playable demo very soon! Wishlist the game on Steam!
🎮https://store.steampowered.com/app/4889280/The_No_Jumpscare_Show/

HEY EVERYONE ! Big news: The NO JUMPSCARE Show - Part 01 is out now for free!

This project kind of grew bigger than I originally thought it would for a short paid game meant to support myself, so I decided to cut it in half and release the first part for you all to enjoy :D Plus, this lets me get back on track with FERALPALS.

#indiegames #horrorgame #indiedev #thenojumpscareshow #horror #GameDev
